entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard on 02/2025 an application for exemption from filing certified copy of order under section 170 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988.
On due consideration and for the reasons stated in the application, the same is allowed.
Also heard on I.A.No. 01/2025 an application for grant of stay.

Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the age of the deceased was more than 60 years whereas the Learned Tribunal found the age of the deceased to 55 years and thereby awarded the excessive compensation.

It is ordered that on appellant's depositing Rs.10,00,000/- out of the total awarded amount before the learned Claims Tribunal with interest within a period of 45 days from today, the recovery of the remaining amount shall remain stayed.
The respondents/claimants would be entitled to withdraw the deposited amount in accordance with terms of the award.
